name: CE_CASH_POOLS
description: This table stores the cash pools set up to aggregate bank account balances for the purpose of optimising interest paid or received and improving liquidity management.

columns.name: CASH_POOL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the cash pool.

columns.name: CASH_POOL_NAME
columns.description: User-defined name of the cash pool.

columns.name: CASH_POOL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the cash pool is physical or notional.

columns.name: CONCENTRATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of concentration activity allowed for physical cash pools. The valid values are ONE_ACCOUNT or TWO_ACCOUNT.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the cash pool.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the legal entity associated with the cash pool. This is a foreign key to XLE_ENTITY_PROFILES.

columns.name: SWEEP_SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED
columns.description: Indicates whether settlement for sweep transactions in the cash pool is required. The valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates wheter the cash pool is enabled. The valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
